document.title: Jamie Jones - Lead Marketing Manager
document.content:
Jamie Jones
Lead Marketing Manager

Skills:
SEO, A/B Testing, Social Media, Email Marketing, Facebook Ads, Data Analysis, SEM, Content Strategy, Google Ads, Brand Management

Experience:
Lead Marketing Manager with extensive experience building scalable systems and leading cross-functional teams. Proven track record of delivering high-quality products on time and mentoring junior developers.

Key Achievements:
• Led development of mission-critical features
• Improved system performance by 40%
• Mentored team members and improved code quality
• Implemented best practices and coding standards
